claim: Nikon CFI Plan Apo Lambda D 10X, part number MRD70170: a dry 10x objective of numerical aperture 0.45 with a working distance of 4 mm, specified for 170 micrometre coverglass.
validity_conditions: Catalog specification for this part number, capped at E3 because a published specification is not a measurement taken here. The magnification 10x is a nominal designation and a string identifier, not a number. Transmission at 1064 nm is not part of this entry, and for this part no transmission curve has been supplied at all.
